facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2014-0149 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 31 October 2014 as a scheduled change under change request; no event precedes it in the record. The change request record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
